name: Suntory Beverage & Food Limited
summary: Suntory Beverage & Food Limited engages in the production and distribution of alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages, and food products in Japan, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas. The company manufactures and distributes mineral water, coffee drinks, tea drinks, carbonated drinks, sports drinks, health supplements, and food for specified health uses.
